note: English-taught single-cycle (laurea magistrale a ciclo unico) programmes at Italian PUBLIC universities for A.Y. 2026/2027. IMAT Medicine/Dentistry/Veterinary seats verified against MUR Decreto Ministeriale n. 1005 del 6 agosto 2026 (Tabella B). English Pharmacy (not IMAT) included where confirmed (Bologna–Rimini; Tor Vergata). Private institutions (Humanitas, San Raffaele, UniCamillus, Campus Bio-Medico, Cattolica, Neuromed) are excluded. Palermo and Sassari have no English Medicine seats in Tabella B for 2026/27. Seats and dates change yearly—confirm on MUR/Universitaly and each university call.

imat.whatItIs: National paper-based admission test (English) for English-taught single-cycle degrees in Medicine and Surgery (LM-41), Dentistry and Dental Prosthodontics (LM-46), and Veterinary Medicine (LM-42) at Italian universities. For A.Y. 2026/2027 the test is regulated by MUR DM n. 1005 of 6 August 2026; questions are prepared by CINECA (not Cambridge Assessment).
imat.whoNeedsIt: Anyone applying to English-taught public (and participating private) Medicine, Dentistry, or Veterinary single-cycle programmes covered by the national call. Italian-taught Medicine uses a different access model (semestre filtro) and does not use IMAT. English Pharmacy (e.g. Bologna–Rimini) does not use IMAT.
imat.universitalyNote: IMAT registration is on Universitaly only. Non-EU residents abroad must ALSO complete Universitaly international pre-enrolment (https://www.universitaly.it/studenti-stranieri) for the university whose non-EU seats they want; without validated pre-enrolment an IMAT score cannot convert into a non-EU seat. Confirm annual deadlines on Universitaly and each university call.
typicalTimeline: Registration on Universitaly: 26 August 2026 – 9 September 2026 at 15:00 (GMT+2) — confirm annually
Test day: 29 September 2026 (Italian venues start 13:30 local; foreign venues adjust for time zone) — confirm annually
Anonymous scores by barcode: 8 October 2026 — confirm annually
Personal paper/score/anagraphic sheet on Universitaly: 19 October 2026 — confirm annually
Named national rankings and first assignments (EU/EU-equivalent): 26 October 2026 — confirm annually
First subsequent scrolling round: 3 November 2026 — confirm annually
sections: Reading skills and knowledge acquired in studies — 4 questions
notes: 60 multiple-choice questions, 5 options each, 100 minutes; max score 90 (+1.5 correct, −0.4 wrong, 0 omitted).
At registration choose irrevocably Medicine+Dentistry track OR Veterinary track (separate national rankings for EU/EU-equivalent).

Non-EU residents abroad compete on each university’s local ranking for reserved non-EU seats; they must also complete Universitaly pre-enrolment for the chosen university (see https://www.universitaly.it/studenti-stranieri).
EU/EU-equivalent minimum eligibility score: 20/90. Non-EU abroad: score > 0 (candidates with all answers blank are not ranked).
English language certificates are not required to sit IMAT; they may be used only for tie-breaking (Annex 3 of the decree).
Some 2026/27 courses are marked *in fase di accreditamento* in Tabella B (Florence Medicine; Padua MedTech; Naples Federico II Veterinary)—final seat delivery depends on accreditation.
IMAT is distinct from the Italian-taught ‘semestre filtro’ reform.
